'''Giyug''' is an extinct and unattested [[Australian Aboriginal language]]. It may (or may not) have been close to [[Wagaydyic languages|Wagaydy]]—perhaps a dialect—but is otherwise unknown. According to Ian Green, it went extinct before the 1920s.
